title: Group H-5 occupancy.
officialText: Emergency alarms for notification of an emergency condition in an HPM facility shall be provided as required in Section 415.8.4.6. A continuous gas-detection system shall be provided for HPM gases in accordance with Section 415.8.7 of this code and the New York City Fire Code.
